dedupe_keys.name: hourly water demand of a mixed district recorded by supplier

description: Arvid Weyrauch and colleagues at KIT and Siemens publish hourly water-consumption measurements from a German supply district with residential, commercial and industrial users. Measurements at a pumping station span January 2016 to March 2021. The April 2024 deposit provides raw, gap-filled and daylight-saving-adjusted CSV variants free under CC BY 4.0. Columns contain dates, hourly intervals, consumption in cubic metres, temperature in Celsius, and rain and sunshine in arbitrary units. A large June 2017 gap was filled with averages from previous years; the adjusted variant forces every day to have 24 hours. These transformations matter for demand forecasting and pump-operation simulations. Exact district identity and weather-unit conversions remain unknown. The resource can test demand models and storage or pumping schedules, but imputed observations must not be treated as independent validation measurements. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified.
